Over 93.5% of Starknet Voting Power Backs Research into Transitioning to Independent Quantum-Resistant Layer 1 Starknet (STRK) tokenholders have approved a research proposal with over 93.5% of voting power supporting an exploration of transitioning Starknet from an Ethereum Layer 2 into an independent, quantum-resistant Layer 1 network. StarkWare plans to release a draft whitepaper in November. The vote strictly authorizes preliminary research and does not constitute formal approval of the transition, which will remain subject to a dedicated governance approval process moving forward. — link

a16z, One of Crypto’s Largest VCs, Plans to Drop “Crypto” From Flagship Fund Name According to The Information, Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), one of the largest venture capital firms in the crypto industry, plans to remove “Crypto” from the name of its flagship blockchain fund and expand its investment focus beyond cryptocurrencies. One of the fund’s founding members is also reportedly departing. In May 2026, a16z Crypto closed its fifth crypto fund at $2.2 billion, roughly half the size of its $4.5 billion fourth fund raised in 2022. — link

Visa in Talks to Acquire Fireblocks for ~$2.5 Billion to Expand Crypto Presence According to Axios, Visa is in talks to acquire crypto custody infrastructure firm Fireblocks in a deal that would value the company at around $2.5 billion. If finalized, the transaction would further expand Visa's footprint in digital asset custody and blockchain-based payment infrastructure. The reports remain subject to further confirmation, and the specific terms and progress of the acquisition negotiations have not been disclosed. In a statement to The Block, Fireblocks stated, "This is news to us, and not true at present time." Meanwhile, Visa stated that the company does not comment on rumors or speculation. — link
